title: Unveiling surface and subsurface atomic vacancies in MoS<sub>2</sub> with lateral force microscopy
abstract:
Nature Communications, Published online: 09 July 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-75151-0

In this work, friction imaging is shown to detect atomic defects in MoS2, even when hidden below the surface, and to classify them through distinct friction fingerprints. This approach offers an accessible way to assess ultrathin material quality.

title: Unravelling the key factors governing O<sub>2</sub> evolution upon charging a reversible LiOH-based nonaqueous Li | |O<sub>2</sub> battery
abstract:
Nature Communications, Published online: 09 July 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-75284-2

LiOH-based Li | |O2 batteries offer high energy density but suffer from poor reversibility. Here, authors study side-reaction origins and key reactive oxygen species during LiOH decomposition upon charge, and propose holistic strategies to effectively improve the Faradaic efficiency.

title: Asymmetric temperature responses to soil moisture drought legacies under anthropogenic forcing
abstract:
Nature Communications, Published online: 09 July 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-75496-6

Annual soil water loss in the year after soil moisture droughts induces a larger annual warming effect than the annual cooling from an equivalent water gain.

title: Quantifying institutional gender inequality in contemporary visual art
abstract:
Nature Communications, Published online: 09 July 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-71470-4

Here, by analyzing the exhibition history and auction sales of over 65,000 contemporary artists across numerous institutions, the authors show gender disparities in visual artist exhibition opportunities an auction success.

title: Neuronal dynamics, timing, and flow of sensory and choice-related information in auditory-prefrontal circuitry
abstract:
Nature Communications, Published online: 08 July 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-75349-2

Cortical interactions during auditory decision-making remain unclear. Here, the authors show that sensory information flows from auditory to prefrontal cortex, whereas choice information flows bidirectionally, revealing dynamic cortical interactions.

title: Dynamic control of laser driven electron acceleration in a photonic structure using programmable optical pulses
abstract:
Nature Communications, Published online: 08 July 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-75233-z

Control of the phase field is essential to enhance the efficiency of dielectric laser accelerator schemes. Here, the authors introduce a software-tunable approach to the optimization and control of the electron beams by combining spatial light modulators with pulsefront tilted beams.

title: Regime transitions in Arctic surface momentum balance reveal persistent and predictable dynamical states
abstract:
Nature Communications, Published online: 08 July 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-75328-7

The study shows that Arctic Ekman pumping can be categorized into seven distinct regimes driven by varying wind, ice, and ocean forces, providing a process-based framework to understand how sea-ice decline alters atmosphere–ocean momentum transfer and upper ocean dynamics.

title: Body surface potential mapping of the cortico-muscular axis using smart textile electrode arrays
abstract:
Nature Communications, Published online: 08 July 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-75134-1

Cutaneous electrophysiology is limited by spatial resolution and wearability constraints. Here, the authors develop a hybrid e-textile electrode array enabling simultaneous cortico-muscular mapping, improving signal quality and decoding of sensory and motor activity for wearable brain-body interfaces
